(14 April 2018) | average attendance = 1,672 | prevseason = [[2017 K League Challenge|2017]] | nextseason = [[2019 K League 2|2019]] }} The '''2018 K League 2''' was the sixth season of the [[K League 2]], the second-highest division in the [[South Korean football league system]].{{Cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tabless/skor2018.html#k2 |title=South Korea 2018 |date=2021-06-23 |access-date=2023-05-23 |publisher=RSSSF}} [[Asan Mugunghwa FC|Asan Mugunghwa]] once again grabbed an opportunity for promotion by winning its second K League 2 title (officially first title after Ansan era), but its owner [[National Police Agency (South Korea)|Korean Police Agency]] did not recruit new players who could meet clubs' requisite for maintenance before the end of the season. Asan Mugunghwa, which was in the process of being dissolved, was finally disqualified from promoting. Runners-up [[Seongnam FC]] directly qualified for the K League 1 instead of Asan Mugunghwa, and the third, fourth, and fifth-placed team advanced to the promotion playoffs. ==Teams== === Team changes === '''Relegated from [[2017 K League Classic|K League Classic]]''' *[[Gwangju FC]] '''Promoted to [[2018 K League 1|K League 1]]''' *[[Gyeongnam FC]] === Stadiums === {|class="wikitable" style="text-align:center" |- !
